authorization_basis: Production runtime read/write dependency and approved target-domain behavior
contract_amendment_1_supersession_reason: Contract.1 chose TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE + OffsetDateTime based on project-wide convention. Normalization Repair.1 changed the implementation to TIMESTAMPTZ + Instant per independent verification. Contract.2 aligns the governance contract with the verified implementation.
creation_rule: INSERT does not set updated_at; column remains NULL until first legitimate business state UPDATE
update_mechanism: SET updated_at = Instant.now() in jOOQ UPDATE statements
business_semantics_definition: render_job.updated_at represents an absolute time point indicating when the same RenderJob execution attempt's externally observable persistent business state was last successfully written to the database by the application. At record creation, updated_at is NULL. Any subsequent update that changes externally observable execution status, progress, result, error, or assignment must set updated_at to the current absolute instant. Pure reads, lock contention failures, or uncommitted transactions must not alter this field.

null_semantics.description: IS NULL means the RenderJob has not undergone any contract-defined business state change since creation.
null_semantics.meaning: No contract-defined successful business state change has been persisted since the record was created.

java_aggregation_result_type: java.time.Instant or an explicitly equivalent absolute-time type
java_api_boundary_type: OffsetDateTime may be used only when an external offset representation is required

timezone_contract.storage_rule: TIMESTAMPTZ stores and compares absolute time points. The database Session timezone affects text display only and does not change the represented absolute instant.
timezone_contract.deterministic_note: The rule is deterministic across all deployment environments: JVM timezone, OS timezone, container timezone, and database Session timezone do not change the represented absolute instant. Comparisons, ordering, and aggregation operate on absolute time semantics.
timezone_contract.superseded_rule: Contract.1 stored TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE via OffsetDateTime.now() preserving JVM timezone, with opaque local timestamp ordering. This rule is SUPERSEDED by the normalization commit b1f974ed which uses TIMESTAMPTZ + Instant.

precision_contract.normalization_behavior: values are normalized to PostgreSQL-supported precision (microseconds)
precision_contract.test_implication: Test and equality comparisons should account for PostgreSQL microsecond precision, not Java nanosecond precision

normative_update_rule: Any new RenderJob persistence write path that changes externally observable business state must also update updated_at. The current method list is NOT a permanent closed list — it is an inventory snapshot as of the normalization date.

approved_read_operations.sql_pattern: WHERE updated_at < cutoff ORDER BY updated_at ASC
approved_read_operations.purpose: Detect jobs stuck in EXECUTING state beyond timeout threshold
approved_read_operations.equality_behavior: updated_at == cutoff does NOT match stale query (strict less-than)

approved_read_operations.purpose: Count stale jobs for operational metrics

approved_read_operations.null_behavior: MIN ignores NULL values; returns NULL when all values are NULL

null_handling_in_queries.comparison_updated_at_lt_cutoff: NULL does not match (NULL < cutoff evaluates to UNKNOWN, row excluded)
null_handling_in_queries.order_by_updated_at_asc: NULLS LAST in ASC ordering (verified by normalization reverification)
null_handling_in_queries.min_updated_at: MIN() automatically ignores NULL values; all-NULL returns NULL

insert_methods.note: INSERT does not include updated_at; column is NULL after creation

retry_contract_note: Authorization of updated_at does not allow Retry to reuse or overwrite old RenderJobs. Retry must continue to create new RenderJob execution attempts. The old RenderJob and its updated_at continue to be preserved as historical fact. TIMESTAMPTZ does not authorize reusing or overwriting old RenderJobs.
fallback_contract_note: No Fallback implementation exists in the current codebase. DG-001 does not authorize implicit Fallback, state overwrite, or switching Backends within the same RenderJob. Future Fallback must still create a new RenderJob.
immutable_execution_attempt_contract: RenderJob identity and execution-attempt facts are immutable. Authorization of updated_at does not expand to: modifying RenderJob identity, overwriting historical execution facts, changing Retry lineage, modifying TimelineRevision identity, modifying Backend identity, or reusing completed RenderJobs. Within the same execution attempt, updating status, progress, error, result, and updated_at is permitted.
index_recommendation: None currently. If stale job query performance degrades, consider index on (status, updated_at).
